description: WP-G1 CASTELLAN'S MARK for the SECOND player: a human Player 2 vs an AI Player 1 (the Attacker). Fixture ork11e_enh_wreckas_redeploy (P1 Orks with Kaptin's Hat, P2 Custodes); setup privilege: P2's Custodian Guard is given Castellan's Mark (it has no list-build effect). Players alternate starting with the Attacker: the AI (P1) resolves its Kaptin's Hat choices first (it keeps its units in place), then the step passes to Player 2 and the redeploy panel lists P2's ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit. Real clicks: [Redeploy] the Custodian Guard, three board clicks inside P2's deployment zone, [Confirm Redeploy] -> the models stand at the clicked spots, one Castellan's Mark use spent, and (P2 having nothing left) the step ends.

steps.comment: setup privileges (see description); P1 is the AI
steps.script:
GameState.state.units["U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B"].meta["enhancements"] = ["Castellan's Mark"]
FactionAbilityManager._razgit_redeploys_used = {"1": 0, "2": 0}
GameState.state.meta["attacker"] = 1
GameState.state.meta["defender"] = 2
AIPlayer.enabled = true
AIPlayer.ai_players = {1: true, 2: false}
return [FactionAbilityManager.get_redeploy_enhancement_name(2), AIPlayer.is_ai_player(1), AIPlayer.is_ai_player(2)]

steps.comment: the AI Attacker resolves first, then the step passes to Player 2
the AI kept its units in place
P2 has nothing left: the step ends
